The surface of the plastic bodies has a slightly mottled, uneven texture rather than the smooth, uniform gloss expected of injection-molded plastic. There are subtle irregularities in the refraction.
The metal hood surrounding the flint wheel on the left lighter appears slightly fused or ill-defined at the edges, lacking the sharp mechanical precision of a real stamped metal part.
